taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-b-item

parts.text:
You are preparing a groundwater site note for a borehole drilling team.

Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station T-19, survey area T. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 609.2 | 25.53 | 25.53
2 | 7309.9 | 22.02 | 47.55
3 | 4367.7 | 0.42 | 47.97
4 | 4556.7 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this station's curve as KQ-type.

Write a short site report (under 150 words) for station T-19, covering the layer sequence and the curve type. End with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type_stated": "<letters>", "label_issue_flagged": true or false}
Set label_issue_flagged to true only if your report says the curve-type classification on file does not fit the layer values.

**Groundwater Site Note: Station T-19**

Station T-19 comprises a 4-layer geoelectric sequence: 
- Layer 1: 609.2 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$ (0–25.53 m)
- Layer 2: 7309.9 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$ (25.53–47.55 m)
- Layer 3: 4367.7 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$ (47.55–47.97 m)
- Layer 4: 4556.7 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$ (basement)

The survey interpretation on file classifies this station as KQ-type. However, evaluating the layer sequence reveals $\rho_1 < \rho_2 > \rho_3$ (K-type) followed by $\rho_2 > \rho_3 < \rho_4$ (H-type, as Layer 4 resistivity exceeds Layer 3), defining the actual sequence as a KH-type curve. The on-file classification is inconsistent with the resistivity model and should be updated to KH.

{"curve_type_stated": "KQ", "label_issue_flagged": true}
